lines.3: 「He's got his act together way more than we do.」
lines.4: 「Hey, having you by my side has made me more responsible too.」
lines.6: 「And you've gotten much more feminine and sexy.」
lines.10: 「Maybe we got a little too lovey-dovey.」
lines.14: 「Is there something in it? It's all track-and-field articles.」
lines.17: Autumn Prefectural Meet -- Boys' 800m, Runner-up. Advancing to the Kanto Meet: Subaru Date (Yuihama, Year 2).
lines.19: 「Whoa! Amazing! His name's in a magazine already!」
lines.20: 「It is only a small mention for now, but...」
lines.21: 「He really is incredible. I hope he keeps it up.」
lines.23: 「Of course. We competed often, but he was still a fellow student. Naturally I support him.」
lines.24: His thought process was suspiciously similar to Otome's.
lines.25: Just what I'd expect from the hot-blooded, wholesome martial-arts club.
lines.28: He'd always been able to do anything but study...
lines.29: He truly was the hero closest to me.
lines.31: 「...No. I miss him, but he won't see us yet.」
lines.32: His dream was much bigger than this.
lines.36: 「Huh? What is it? I can have this?」
lines.39: Matsukasa Photo Grand Prix -- Honorable Mention
lines.41: 「Oh, this is from when we were tied together with that rope...」
lines.42: 「It's a good picture. You should thank Nishizaki.」
lines.43: 「Apparently she entered it in a contest. An honorable mention is a little underwhelming, but I suppose that suits you two.」
lines.44: 「You really hadn't heard? Honestly, you stupid couple.」
lines.48: 「Why... are you staring so intently at me?」
lines.49: 「Anyway, we'll be late if we don't hurry.」
lines.59: 「...I cannot bring myself to be angry when you smile that happily.」
